integrity_notes: Every published assertion rests on the included complete finite face-poset Morse certificate, exact signed Lefschetz evaluation, and standard topological/representation-theoretic deductions. The package makes no claim of external or independent verification or of an infinite-family generalization.
limitations: The integral homology and rational D6 representation are determined for the finite seven-hexagon coronene graph. The integral homotopy type (possible unstable attaching maps), torsion in integral quotient homology, and wider benzenoid families are not determined. Residual overlap from unindexed exact studies is possible.
title: Mixed integral independence homology and dihedral symmetry of the coronene graph
